title: dca-tools
description: Dollar-cost-averaging backtests on real historical data for crypto, stocks and commodities.
summary: Dollar-cost-averaging backtests on real historical data for crypto, stocks and commodities.
offersHint: Dollar-cost-averaging backtests on real historical data for crypto, stocks and commodities. · Remote MCP (streamable-http) at https://dcamethod.com/api/mcp

toolsPreview.name: list_assets
toolsPreview.description: Returns every asset dcamethod.com can backtest, with category, calculator URL and whether historical data is available. Optional category filter: crypto, stocks, commodities.

toolsPreview.name: run_dca_backtest
toolsPreview.description: Simulates dollar-cost averaging into one asset using dcamethod.com's own engine and historical price data. Returns total invested, final value, profit, CAGR, average buy price, best/worst month and purchase count. Dates outside the available range are clamped to it.

toolsPreview.name: get_method
toolsPreview.description: Returns a concise explanation of the dollar-cost-averaging method plus links to the methodology, calculators and blog.
